claim: A targetCapacity value of less than 100% on an ECS Auto Scaling group capacity provider represents the amount of free capacity (EC2 instances) that needs to be present in the cluster, and spare capacity helps future tasks launch more quickly because the Auto Scaling group does not have to launch more instances.
question: What does the ECS capacity provider targetCapacity setting control?

values.display: represents the amount of free capacity (Amazon EC2 instances) that need to be present in the cluster
helps future tasks launch more quickly

qualifiers.scope: Amazon ECS Auto Scaling group capacity providers

evidence.quote: A `targetCapacity` value of less than 100% represents the amount of free capacity (Amazon EC2 instances) that need to be present in the cluster.
You can set the `targetCapacity` percentage so that you have spare capacity. This helps future tasks launch more quickly because the Auto Scaling group does not have to launch more instances.
